name: purchase case workflow
sql:
CREATE TABLE purchase_case_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  case_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(case_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('created','reviewed')),
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('document','bank_transaction','payable')),
  source_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_id > 0),
  source_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_fingerprint)=64),
  documentation_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(documentation_outcome IN ('unresolved','ordinary_evidence_sufficient','alternative_evidence_assessed')),
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(note) <= 2000),
  prior_event_hash TEXT,
  event_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_hash)=64),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  program TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(program)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(case_id, version)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX purchase_case_primary_source_once ON purchase_case_events(source_kind,source_id) WHERE event_type='created';
CREATE INDEX purchase_case_events_current ON purchase_case_events(case_id,version DESC,id DESC);
CREATE VIEW current_purchase_cases AS
 SELECT event.* FROM purchase_case_events event
 JOIN (SELECT case_id,MAX(version) version FROM purchase_case_events GROUP BY case_id) current
   ON current.case_id=event.case_id AND current.version=event.version;
CREATE TRIGGER purchase_case_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON purchase_case_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'purchase cases are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER purchase_case_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON purchase_case_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'purchase cases are append-only'); END;
